name: today
title: The programme today
subtitle: What is late, what needs approving, who is owed and what has gone quiet. Rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Content late
sections.note: Accepted deliverables past their due date with no post.
sections.sql: select code, creator, campaign, replace(kind, '_', ' ') as kind, due_on, days_late from v_deliverables where state = 'overdue' and collab_stage = 'accepted' order by due_on

sections.title: Waiting for approval
sections.sql: select code, creator, campaign, replace(kind, '_', ' ') as kind, draft_received_on, due_on, case when is_testimonial and brand_category = 'therapeutic' and market like '%AU%' then 'TESTIMONIAL: cannot be approved' else '' end as warning from v_deliverables where state = 'awaiting approval' and collab_stage = 'accepted' order by draft_received_on

sections.title: Posts with a disclosure problem
sections.note: No ad label, a label that is not on the accepted list, or a label that is not upfront.
sections.sql: select code, creator, campaign, posted_on, coalesce(disclosure_label, 'NONE') as label, case when label_upfront then 'yes' else 'NO' end as upfront, post_url from v_deliverables where posted_on is not null and collab_stage <> 'cancelled' and (disclosure_label is null or label_upfront is not true or position(lower(disclosure_label) in coalesce((select value from settings where key = 'disclosure_labels'), '#ad')) = 0) order by posted_on

sections.title: Running as ads past usage rights
sections.sql: select code, creator, brand, usage_rights_until, ad_running_since from v_deliverables where ad_running and (usage_rights_until is null or usage_rights_until < biz_today())

sections.title: Gifts in transit
sections.sql: select g.code, k.creator, g.product, g.sent_on, g.courier, g.tracking, biz_today() - g.sent_on as days from gifts g join v_collabs k on k.id = g.collaboration_id where g.delivered_on is null order by g.sent_on

name: campaigns
title: Campaigns
subtitle: Budget, spend and results per campaign

sections.title: Every campaign
sections.sql: select code, name, brand, status, budget_cents, (fees_cents + gifts_cents) as committed_cents, posted, engagements, code_uses, sales_cents from v_campaign_results where status <> 'cancelled' order by starts_on desc

name: creators
title: Creators
subtitle: Every creator who has posted, on what an engagement and a sale really cost

sections.title: Cost per result
sections.note: Cost is fees plus product sent. Engagements are likes, comments, shares and saves from the latest numbers captured.
sections.sql: select creator, handle, followers, posted, cost_cents, engagements, round(cost_cents::numeric / nullif(engagements, 0), 2) as cents_per_engagement, code_uses, sales_cents, posted_late from v_creator_performance where posted > 0 order by cost_cents::numeric / nullif(engagements, 0)

sections.title: Not yet worked with
sections.sql: select creator, handle, platform, followers, engagement_rate, status from v_creator_performance where collabs = 0 and status in ('prospect', 'contacted', 'active') order by engagement_rate desc nulls last
